hints.title: Value One Invariant
hints.text: The smallest missing positive integer is one unless the number one is present in that node subtree.

hints.title: Restricted Path of Interest
hints.text: Only nodes on the direct ancestor path from the node containing value one to the tree root can have answers strictly greater than one.

hints.title: Climbing Ancestors with Monotonic Search
hints.text: Ascend along the parent path from node one, expanding the visited subtree nodes and incrementing missing candidate integer until not found.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) because each node and each genetic value is visited at most once during ancestor ascent
complexity.space: O(N) for tree adjacency list, visited tracking, and seen value hash set
variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Monotonic missing integer pointer guarantees linear overall time complexity.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running a full search per node yields quadratic time for skewed tree topologies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining global seen set allows single traversal across ancestor climb.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only ancestor path of value one needs processing, yielding linear time.
